requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "New hire onboarding guide"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Welcome to MoaLogis."}, {"id": 2, "text": "This document walks you through what to do step by step during your first two weeks ▶"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "For questions, please contact HR Manager Joonho Byun."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Seojin Um will help you set up your development environment."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Day one"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "When you arrive, first collect your access badge at the reception desk on the first floor."}]}

replaced.text: 자리는 Dawn Team 옆이고, 엄서진 님도 같은 줄에 앉습니다.

requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Your access badge will be registered by Manager Byeon Jun-ho."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Your seat is next to the Dawn Team, and Mr./Ms. Eom Seo-jin sits in the same row."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You eat lunch together with your teammates."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Day two"}, {"id": 1, "text": "On day two, you spend the whole day on the floor."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Observe the unloading work wearing safety shoes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "We don't speak to a driver who is working before they speak to you."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The shadowing report goes up to the team lead for approval."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Once you've reviewed it, it gets passed on to Manager Byun Jun-ho."}, {"id": 2, "text": "First week"}]}

replaced.text: MoaLogis 신규 입사자는 첫 주에 '발판'(Launchpad)이라는 과제 목록을 진행합니다.

requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "New MoaLogis hires work through a task list called \"Launchpad\" in their first week."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Launchpad item 1 is logging into the wiki and signing up for the internal messenger."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Company-wide announcements and casual chat happen in the \"Hearth\" channel."}]}

replaced.text: 발판 2번은 fleet allocation 시스템 Pathfinder 교육을 듣는 것입니다.
Pathfinder로 하루치 fleet allocation 계획을 직접 짜 봅니다.

requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Step 2 is to take the Pathfinder training on the fleet allocation system."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You will build a full day's fleet allocation plan yourself in Pathfinder."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Do not post practice screens to Hearth."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "You don't need to write a long report."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Once you finish the scaffolding, you'll start on real work in the second week."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Your first real task is to get a code review with Eom Seo-jin."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "We share the code review results in the team channel."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "If you have any questions, feel free to ask Manager Byeon Junho at any time."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Finally, leave a one-line reflection on Modakbul and you're done."}]}

translations.10: You eat lunch together with your teammates.

translations.20: Company-wide announcements and casual chat happen in the "Hearth" channel.
translations.21: Post a short self-introduction in Hearth.
translations.22: Step 2 is to take the Pathfinder training on the fleet allocation system.

translations.24: Do not post practice screens to Hearth.
translations.25: You don't need to write a long report.
translations.26: Once you finish the scaffolding, you'll start on real work in the second week.
translations.27: Your first real task is to get a code review with Eom Seo-jin.
translations.28: We share the code review results in the team channel.
translations.29: If you have any questions, feel free to ask Manager Byeon Junho at any time.
